_doc: Declarative world spec for cw01-e02 (ancestral efficiency ratchet). Written during PREFLIGHT, before implementation. The ratchet substrate is PURELY ECONOMIC: T2 is cheaper on a normalised payload, T3 is cheaper on a factored one. No rule rewards the ordering T1->T2->T3; if a lineage finds it, that is a finding.

payload._note: Items arrive as structured payloads. size/dispersion/structure are physical properties that transformations change and prices read. Nothing is named 'feature' or 'model'.

transformations._critical: The ordering discount is the ratchet substrate and MUST be verified numerically by Q2. If T2 is not actually cheaper after T1, there is nothing for a ratchet to stand on.

T4_bind._note: reuses e01's verified occupancy economics; retention is NOT the subject here

genome._note: Small real-valued policy vector, as in e01. Honest limitation: not a rich program.
genome._neutral_genes: neutral_a and neutral_b have NO phenotype by construction. They are the cost-matched sham for K1: reverting them must cost ~0. e01 (CW01-D011) had a gene under selection with no phenotype BY ACCIDENT; here two are declared deliberately and must be verified inert by Q6.

pressure._forbidden: raw fitness must never be used as the progress measure

gain_detection._critical: Thresholds are fixed HERE, before running. A 'gain' fitted to a wiggle in the curve manufactures ratchets from noise (threat 2).
gain_detection.definition: a generation g is a GAIN if lineage mean at g exceeds the trailing baseline by >= effect_size_min_pct AND the elevated level persists for >= persistence_generations

_calibration.why: The original 2.0% threshold sat far below the noise floor: the no-selection null has a lineage mean sd of 6.6-7.5% RELATIVE. A percent-lift criterion alone cannot separate a step from sampling variance at that scale (CW01-D022).
_calibration.method: 3 independent no-selection nulls, 80 generations x 64 organisms each, 210 pooled candidate windows. Operating point set at the null's 99th percentile -- CALIBRATED from measurement, not tuned until the null went quiet.
_calibration.RESOLUTION_LIMIT: A 10% planted step produced one gain at gen 65 while the true step was at gen 40. Near the floor, localization is unreliable. Since ratchet condition 1 is TEMPORAL ORDERING, ordering claims require gains above ordering_bar_pct (20%), where localization was verified exact. A gain between 12.3% and 20% may be COUNTED but may NOT carry an ordering claim.
_calibration.consequence: Ratchets smaller than ~12.3% are undetectable by this instrument. That is a stated limit; if e02 returns NULL it must be read as 'no ratchet above the detection floor', never as 'no ratchet'.

K1_revert_A.effect: restore the earlier gain's genes to pre-A ancestral values
K1_revert_A.sham: revert an equal number of NEUTRAL genes (neutral_a/neutral_b)
K1_revert_A._test: ratchet requires loss(revert A from A+B) > gain(A alone, as measured when it arrived)

K2_transplant_B.effect: install the later gain's genes into the PRE-A ancestor
K2_transplant_B.sham: install them into the post-A background (expected ~neutral)
K2_transplant_B._test: B must be worth more on the foundation than without it

K3_ancestor_restoration.effect: run the original ancestor in the descendant's world

K4_price_shift.effect: re-run evolved lineages under altered transformation prices

K6_frozen_transfer.effect: unseen world frozen at evaluation time

measurements.primary: delta(useful_information_transformed / resource_cost) vs ancestor, matched world+budget
measurements.ratchet_statistic: loss(K1 revert A) - gain(A when it arrived); superadditive if > 0

qualify_predicates._rule: ALL must pass before science budget is spent. Q9-Q12 are STANDING GATES promoted from e01's failures (PACKAGE.md compression items).
qualify_predicates.Q1_prices_positive: every transformation cost > 0 and occupancy price > 0
qualify_predicates.Q2_ordering_discount_is_real: measured numerically: cost(T2 | after T1) < cost(T2 | no T1), and cost(T3 | after T2) < cost(T3 | no T2). Without this there is no ratchet substrate.
qualify_predicates.Q3_shams_are_cost_matched: K1's sham reverts an equal number of genes and costs the same; reverting genes must cost NO resources (threat 3)
qualify_predicates.Q4_seeds_reconstructible: lib/seeds.py, already verified cross-process in e01; re-asserted for this attempt_id
qualify_predicates.Q5_durable_without_redis: at least one row written and fully interpretable with redis import blocked
qualify_predicates.Q6_neutral_genes_are_inert: neutral_a/neutral_b have NO measurable effect: perturbing them changes no metric. They are the K1 sham, so if they are not inert the sham is not a sham.
qualify_predicates.Q7_pressure_actually_binds: observed payload sizes and step budget make T3 non-trivial; items cannot all be completed free
qualify_predicates.Q8_not_a_free_lunch: REACHABILITY PROBE: a hand-built best-case orderer (T1->T2->T3) must beat a hand-built worst-case (random order / no ordering), AND a badly-configured orderer must LOSE. The effect must be able to go both ways.
qualify_predicates.Q9_mechanism_fires: STANDING GATE: in the hand-built best case, t1_applied/t2_applied are non-zero and the ordering actually occurs. e01 ran a whole experiment with the mechanism at zero (CW01-D009).
qualify_predicates.Q10_matched_arms: STANDING GATE: with the mechanism disabled, matched arms must produce BIT-IDENTICAL info from the same stream seed. e01's arms were silently unmatched and produced a fake +40% (CW01-D010).
qualify_predicates.Q11_gain_detector_calibrated_on_null: STANDING GATE, two-sided: on >=2 held-out no-selection nulls the detector must report ZERO gains, AND synthetic planted steps at/above the threshold must be FOUND AT THE RIGHT GENERATION. A null-only test would pass a detector that is simply blind.
qualify_predicates.Q12_disposition_rule_is_executable: STANDING GATE: the disposition must be computed by code derived from PREREGISTRATION.md INCLUDING the replication clause. e01's driver awarded COMPLETE on a single seed (CW01-D016).

backend_counterfactual.requirement_IX: organism-visible physics of T4 reproducible on a second backend
backend_counterfactual.equivalence_test: same seeds + same arm on both backends must produce identical per-organism metric vectors
backend_counterfactual.cap_rule: if not exercised within timebox, disposition is capped at INCONCLUSIVE and may NOT be COMPLETE

arms._critical: Arms differ ONLY in which affordances are enabled. The world stream is drawn from a stream_seed that never sees the arm (CW01-D010: arm-dependent seeding produced a fake +40% advantage in e01). Q10 asserts bit-identical info when the mechanism is disabled.

control_no_T1._tests: no normalise -> dispersion stays high -> T2 stays expensive and the factor_threshold gate rarely opens. This is the foundation ablation.

control_no_T2._tests: no factoring -> structure never falls -> T1 becomes pure cost

control_no_T4._tests: no retention; isolates the ordering effect from e01's retention effect

amendments.trigger: Q11 two-sided calibration failed: the detector fired on pure noise
changes: effect_size_min_pct 2.0 -> 12.3 (null lift p99), added min_sd_separation 1.3 (null sd-sep p99)
added ordering_bar_pct 20.0: detection and ORDERING now have different bars, because near-floor gains are mislocated and ratchet condition 1 depends on location
Q11 restated as explicitly two-sided (null AND planted-step localization)
amendments._no_result_observed: No selection run has been performed. These are pre-data corrections to the instrument; the positive controls were SYNTHETIC precisely to avoid peeking.
